tool_description: Return deterministic completed-product counts and production rates for one or more production lines over one concrete time interval.
server_instruction: Use get_production_statistics when the requested operation is production quantity, completed production, throughput, or production rate over a period. date_from, date_to, and line_ids are required for the MCP call. A calendar-day request means the complete day from 00:00:00 to the following midnight. Do not invent a missing temporal scope; when the user explicitly requests the whole available period, resolve the concrete available MES bounds before calling the tool.

field_descriptions.date_from: Inclusive timezone-naive ISO-8601 start of the production interval.
field_descriptions.date_to: Timezone-naive ISO-8601 end of the production interval. It must be later than date_from.
field_descriptions.line_ids: One to four production line IDs selected from 1, 2, 3, and 4.
